description_expanded: OverviewGulf FrontUPDATED GULF FRONT - 2 Stories of Gulf Views -PoolThe Space Blue Tide 1B – Gulf-Front Escape with Stunning Views! QUICK HIGHLIGHTS: Direct Gulf-Front Condo – Breathtaking panoramic beach views from both levels Swift Beach Access – Private stairway from the second-floor balcony to the beach walk-down Community Pool – Perfect for a refreshing dip after a day on the sand Spacious 2-Bedroom, 2-Bathroom Layout – Sleeps 6 comfortably Built-in Wine Cooler & Wet Bar – Enjoy a coastal happy hour with ease 2 Adult Bikes Included – Explore 30A’s best spots on two wheels Prime Location – Just minutes from Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, & Seagrove dining & shopping Complimentary Wi-Fi – Stay connected while you relax 1 Assigned Parking Spot + Limited Overflow – Convenient for your stay Professionally Managed – 24/7 Guest Service for a seamless experienceWelcome to Blue Tide 1BFor your next beach vacation look no further than Blue Tide 1B, a fabulous two-story beach haven with unbeatable Gulf front views. Both the master bedroom and guest bedroom boast private bathrooms and the condominium sleeps up to six guests making it the perfect spot for a family or couples' getaway. Bountiful accommodations include gulf views throughout, an open floor plan in the common areas, wet bar, stainless steel appliances, built-in wine cooler, private beach access and a community pool. This impeccably kept, two-bedroom, two-bathroom condo sits between Rosemary Beach and Seagrove Beach allowing for quick access to a variety of shopping and dining options along the coast. Wonderful stretch of grass running along the back side of the building...great for kids to play. Stairs leading from the second-floor balcony to the grass area leading to the beach walk-down. No need to walk around the building. One assigned parking space per unit plus visitor parking available.MULTIPLE FAMILIES OR GUESTS? SEE VRBO #'s 655355 and 655357 in the same complex. 655355 is a 1 story, 1 BR unit located just below this unit on the ground floor.House Rules**No Pets!****No Smoking!****No Parties!****The primary renter must be at least 25 years old****No units will be rented to vacationing students or young adults under 25 unaccompanied by a responsible parent or guardian at a ratio of three (3) children/young adults to one (1) adult over the age of 25****30A Vacay rental agreement is required to be signed prior to arrival**SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS (6):Master Bedroom, Second Floor: King Bed, Private BathroomGuest Bedroom, Second Floor: King Bed, Two Twin Beds, Private BathroomAREA ATTRACTIONS:This easygoing beach neighborhood is the perfect place to escape for a beach vacation. Spend a day wandering through the shops and sights of Seacrest — you’ll spot everything from gorgeous dune lakes to gourmet restaurants. Then, unwind with a stroll along Seacrest’s sugar-white sand.A lively community gathers in Seacrest’s Peddler’s Pavilion. Sip coffee on an outdoor patio, stock up on homemade sweet treats, or rent a bicycle and go exploring. With wide-open green spaces and plenty of ecosploring opportunities, this beach neighborhood is a perfect fit for active vacationers.Show less
